notes: Access: same Akamai interstitial solve as bs21/na21 (curl_cffi chrome impersonation). The one footer link that mentions sale-adjacent wording is 'WITHDRAWAL OF ITEMS' -> /ae/withdrawn-from-sale-n5187 (Arabic: withdrawal-of-products-worded page) - opened it directly: its serverApp-state contains zero 'gridElements', zero 'productIds', zero 'ccIds' keys anywhere (verified programmatically), i.e. it is not a product listing at all - it is a legal/compliance notice page about products withdrawn/recalled from sale, not a merchandising Clearance page. Checked the AE-specific category sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-ae-0.xml.gz, 592 URLs) - grepped for sale/clearance/outlet/discount/offer/promo - zero matches. Checked direct URL guesses (/ae/sale, /ae/clearance, /ae/outlet, /ae/final-sale, /ae/last-chance) - every one returns the site's soft-404 template (HTTP 200, title 'Error Page | Zara Home UAE'), confirming these paths do not exist. Store config (/itxrest/2/catalog/store/85009931) does list a second, distinct catalog identifier 'ZH_EAST_SALE' (id 80289985, type 3) alongside the main 'ZH_EAST_SEASON' catalog (id 50333562, the catalog every real category page on this site is served from) - this shows the ITX commerce platform has a sale-catalog concept configured for this store, but no nav link, footer link, sitemap entry, homepage widget, or resolvable URL exposes any category under that catalog to AE shoppers; it is present in backend config only, not surfaced anywhere navigable. Given no page anywhere on the site is labelled or taxonomised as Sale/Clearance/Outlet at all (not even a generic 'Sale' page to weigh under the Sale-vs-Clearance test), there is nothing ambiguous to flag - this is a clean absence, not an uncertain judgment call.
